usage: A common noun for the precious metal platinum; in Hong Kong it often appears in jewellery and luxury-shopping contexts.
Use it directly after measurement or material words, e.g. with prices, rings, necklaces, or watches when talking about the metal itself.
In everyday speech, people may say 白金 when they mean a platinum item, not just the material in general.
For clear contrast, it is often mentioned alongside 黃金 and 銀 in jewellery or investment discussions.
